captions.detailed: An industrial-style floor air pump featuring a tall, bright orange main cylinder mounted on a wide, black foot stabilizer base. It is equipped with a black T-handle grip at the top connected to a central piston rod, a circular pressure gauge on the side, and a flexible black hose leading to the base. For articulation, the T-handle and piston rod slide vertically along the cylinder axis, the lower stabilizer bar extends horizontally through the base, and a folding handle sleeve rotates around the crossbar.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of an industrial floor air pump with a tall orange cylinder, a black base, a side-mounted pressure gauge, and a top T-handle. Implement prismatic articulation for the vertical piston rod and the telescoping lower stabilizer bar, and continuous rotational joint articulation for the folding handle grip sleeve.
captions.factory: The model is constructed by defining three main moving assemblies. First, the stationary base and main cylinder are built using a cylinder for the orange body, a box for the base, a smaller cylinder and disc for the side pressure gauge, and a swept curve for the hose. Second, the piston rod and T-handle are modeled as a vertical cylinder connected to a horizontal crossbar handle. Third, the telescoping stabilizer bar is created as a horizontal square tube with end pads, and the handle grip is built as a hollowed sleeve. These components are joined with prismatic joints for the vertical pump stroke and horizontal stabilizer extension, and a continuous joint for the rotating handle grip.
